source_text: Sounds like Sister Judy.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Sounds like Sister Judy.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Sounds like Sister Judy."

translation: Brzmi jak siostra Judy.

source_text: 1Hero. I sense some conflict in your mind.

structure.raw_value: ArWoCl.1Hero. I sense some conflict in your mind.
structure.script_literal: "ArWoCl.1Hero. I sense some conflict in your mind."

translation: 1Hero. Wyczuwam w tobie rozterkę.

source_text: Arianna… Were you meant to be found by Sister Judy?

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Arianna… Were you meant to be found by Sister Judy?
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Arianna… Were you meant to be found by Sister Judy?"

translation: Arianna… Czy siostra Judy miała cię odnaleźć?

source_text: There are no mistakes in God's will. You are the one who found the Oracle and you are the one I will guide.

structure.raw_value: ArHaOp.There are no mistakes in God's will. You are the one who found the Oracle and you are the one I will guide.
structure.script_literal: "ArHaOp.There are no mistakes in God's will. You are the one who found the Oracle and you are the one I will guide."

translation: W woli Boga nie ma przypadków. To ty odnalazłeś Wyrocznię i to ciebie będę prowadzić.

source_text: I trust you, Arianna. I hope I’m doing the right thing.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I trust you, Arianna. I hope I’m doing the right thing.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I trust you, Arianna. I hope I’m doing the right thing."

translation: Ufam ci, Arianno. Mam nadzieję, że robię dobrze.

source_text: I will always tell you the truth. I am incapable of anything else.

structure.raw_value: ArHaEx.I will always tell you the truth. I am incapable of anything else.
structure.script_literal: "ArHaEx.I will always tell you the truth. I am incapable of anything else."

translation: Zawsze powiem ci prawdę. Nie potrafię inaczej.

source_text: It’s getting late… Is it too late to help Carol out with the tractor?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.It’s getting late… Is it too late to help Carol out with the tractor?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.It’s getting late… Is it too late to help Carol out with the tractor?"

translation: Robi się późno… Czy nie jest za późno, by pomóc Carol przy traktorze?

source_text: The night is young.

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx.The night is young.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx.The night is young."

translation: Noc jest młoda.

source_text: No sign of the nun. Let’s hurry.

structure.raw_value: NeFlEx.No sign of the nun. Let’s hurry.
structure.script_literal: "NeFlEx.No sign of the nun. Let’s hurry."

translation: Ani śladu zakonnicy. Pospieszmy się.

source_text: You’re crazy, Nellie.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.You’re crazy, Nellie.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.You’re crazy, Nellie."

translation: Zwariowałaś, Nellie.

source_text: Sorry, Father. I went into the woods without telling you.

structure.raw_value: JuSaEx.Sorry, Father. I went into the woods without telling you.
structure.script_literal: "JuSaEx.Sorry, Father. I went into the woods without telling you."

translation: Przepraszam, ojcze. Poszłam do lasu, nie mówiąc ci.

source_text: I thought you went to Chloe’s house.

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe^.I thought you went to Chloe’s house.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe^.I thought you went to Chloe’s house."

translation: Myślałem, że poszłaś do domu Chloe.

source_text: It’s all good now. I think we had a little mixup.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.It’s all good now. I think we had a little mixup.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.It’s all good now. I think we had a little mixup."

translation: Już wszystko dobrze. Chyba mieliśmy małe nieporozumienie.

source_text: You need to be careful, Sister Judy. There are lots of dangers out there.

structure.raw_value: BrSaEx^.You need to be careful, Sister Judy. There are lots of dangers out there.
structure.script_literal: "BrSaEx^.You need to be careful, Sister Judy. There are lots of dangers out there."

translation: Musisz uważać, siostro Judy. Na zewnątrz czyha wiele niebezpieczeństw.

source_text: I know, Father. I won’t do it again.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.I know, Father. I won’t do it again.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.I know, Father. I won’t do it again."

translation: Wiem, ojcze. Już tego nie zrobię.

source_text: Let’s hope that officers ward off those criminals.

structure.raw_value: BrFrEx^.Let’s hope that officers ward off those criminals.
structure.script_literal: "BrFrEx^.Let’s hope that officers ward off those criminals."

translation: Miejmy nadzieję, że funkcjonariusze odstraszą tych przestępców.

source_text: I’m going to do everything I can to end this soon.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I’m going to do everything I can to end this soon.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I’m going to do everything I can to end this soon."

translation: Zrobię wszystko, co w mojej mocy, by wkrótce to zakończyć.

source_text: I will pray for it.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.I will pray for it.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.I will pray for it."

translation: Będę się o to modlić.

source_text: I… I should get back to my studies.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.I… I should get back to my studies.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.I… I should get back to my studies."

translation: Ja… Ja powinnam wrócić do nauki.

source_text: Chloe left not long ago. Are you looking for her?

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.Chloe left not long ago. Are you looking for her?
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.Chloe left not long ago. Are you looking for her?"

translation: Chloe wyszła niedawno. Szukasz jej?

source_text: Another evening visit from 1Hero. How wonderful.

structure.raw_value: JuHaAg.Another evening visit from 1Hero. How wonderful.
structure.script_literal: "JuHaAg.Another evening visit from 1Hero. How wonderful."

translation: Kolejna wieczorna wizyta 1Hero. Jak cudownie.

source_text: It’s good to see you again too, Sister Judy.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.It’s good to see you again too, Sister Judy.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.It’s good to see you again too, Sister Judy."

translation: Ciebie też miło znów widzieć, siostro Judy.

source_text: Hopefully you don't have to save me from any spiders this time.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.Hopefully you don't have to save me from any spiders this time.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.Hopefully you don't have to save me from any spiders this time."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że tym razem nie będziesz musiał ratować mnie przed pająkami.

source_text: Haha, I'm your knight in shining armor.

structure.raw_value: McFrOpNo3.Haha, I'm your knight in shining armor.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOpNo3.Haha, I'm your knight in shining armor."

translation: Haha, jestem twoim rycerzem w lśniącej zbroi.

source_text: Would you like to stay a while? I sure do enjoy your company.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.Would you like to stay a while? I sure do enjoy your company.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.Would you like to stay a while? I sure do enjoy your company."

translation: Zostaniesz na chwilę? Naprawdę lubię twoje towarzystwo.

source_text: I’d like that, but I have somewhere to be. Maybe later this evening?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I’d like that, but I have somewhere to be. Maybe later this evening?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I’d like that, but I have somewhere to be. Maybe later this evening?"

translation: Chciałbym, ale muszę być gdzie indziej. Może później wieczorem?

source_text: I’ll look forward to it.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.I’ll look forward to it.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.I’ll look forward to it."

translation: Będę czekać.

source_text: I look forward to spending time with you this evening.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.I look forward to spending time with you this evening.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.I look forward to spending time with you this evening."

translation: Nie mogę się doczekać, by spędzić z tobą wieczór.

source_text: Judy? Are you okay?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Judy? Are you okay?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Judy? Are you okay?"

translation: Judy? Wszystko w porządku?

source_text: Have any luck?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Have any luck?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Have any luck?"

translation: Miałaś szczęście?

source_text: No sign of her yet. But I’ll keep looking.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.No sign of her yet. But I’ll keep looking.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.No sign of her yet. But I’ll keep looking."

translation: Jeszcze ani śladu. Ale będę szukać dalej.

source_text: I’ve dealt with my share of difficult women in my life, but this Madalyn woman sounds like more than a handful.

structure.raw_value: BrBaOp.I’ve dealt with my share of difficult women in my life, but this Madalyn woman sounds like more than a handful.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaOp.I’ve dealt with my share of difficult women in my life, but this Madalyn woman sounds like more than a handful."

translation: Miałem do czynienia z trudnymi kobietami w życiu, ale ta Madalyn to chyba coś więcej niż trudny orzech do zgryzienia.

source_text: I better study up on exorcism.

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe.I better study up on exorcism.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe.I better study up on exorcism."

translation: Lepiej podszkolę się z egzorcyzmów.

source_text: Well if it isn’t 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: BrFlDe.Well if it isn’t 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlDe.Well if it isn’t 1Hero."

translation: No proszę, a toż to 1Hero.

source_text: Uhh… Hi, Father Solomon.

structure.raw_value: McFrCl.Uhh… Hi, Father Solomon.
structure.script_literal: "McFrCl.Uhh… Hi, Father Solomon."

translation: Yyy… Cześć, ojcze Solomonie.

source_text: And what brings you here to the church on this lovely evening?

structure.raw_value: BrFlEx.And what brings you here to the church on this lovely evening?
structure.script_literal: "BrFlEx.And what brings you here to the church on this lovely evening?"

translation: I co sprowadza cię o tej pięknej porze do kościoła?

source_text: Just saying hi to Sister Judy.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Just saying hi to Sister Judy.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Just saying hi to Sister Judy."

translation: Tak tylko wpadłem przywitać się z siostrą Judy.

source_text: Of course… of course.  A young handsome man like you I’m sure puts Sister Judy’s mind at ease just before bedtime.

structure.raw_value: BrFlDe.Of course… of course.  A young handsome man like you I’m sure puts Sister Judy’s mind at ease just before bedtime.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlDe.Of course… of course.  A young handsome man like you I’m sure puts Sister Judy’s mind at ease just before bedtime."

translation: Oczywiście… oczywiście. Przystojny młodzieniec jak ty na pewno koi myśli siostry Judy przed snem.

source_text: You know me… I’m here to help.

structure.raw_value: McHaOp.You know me… I’m here to help.
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp.You know me… I’m here to help."

translation: Znasz mnie… Jestem tu, by pomóc.

source_text: A detective and a gentleman.

structure.raw_value: BrFlEx.A detective and a gentleman.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlEx.A detective and a gentleman."

translation: Detektyw i dżentelmen.

source_text: Let me smell your fingers.

structure.raw_value: BrFlDe.Let me smell your fingers.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlDe.Let me smell your fingers."

translation: Daj powąchać palce.

source_text: Hahahahahaha! You should see your face.

structure.raw_value: BrHaOpNo2.Hahahahahaha! You should see your face.
structure.script_literal: "BrHaOpNo2.Hahahahahaha! You should see your face. "

translation: Hahahahahaha! Powinieneś zobaczyć swoją minę.

source_text: No worries, 1Hero. I’m sure you’re a better man than me at your age.

structure.raw_value: BrFlOp.No worries, 1Hero. I’m sure you’re a better man than me at your age.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlOp.No worries, 1Hero. I’m sure you’re a better man than me at your age."

translation: Spoko, 1Hero. Jestem pewien, że jesteś lepszym człowiekiem niż ja w twoim wieku.

source_text: Ha. Right.

structure.raw_value: McWoDeNo4.Ha. Right.
structure.script_literal: "McWoDeNo4.Ha. Right."

translation: Ha. Jasne.

source_text: That’s not the kind of joke I’d expect to hear from an ordained priest of the church.

structure.raw_value: McFrCl.That’s not the kind of joke I’d expect to hear from an ordained priest of the church.
structure.script_literal: "McFrCl.That’s not the kind of joke I’d expect to hear from an ordained priest of the church."

translation: Nie tego żartu spodziewałbym się po wyświęconym kapłanie.

source_text: Well, I'm not a typical priest.

structure.raw_value: BrFrEx.Well, I'm not a typical priest.
structure.script_literal: "BrFrEx.Well, I'm not a typical priest."

translation: Cóż, nie jestem typowym księdzem.

source_text: I'm starting to wonder just how wild your past really was.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.I'm starting to wonder just how wild your past really was.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.I'm starting to wonder just how wild your past really was."

translation: Zaczynam się zastanawiać, jak dzika była twoja przeszłość.

source_text: I've done things a man your age has probably never even heard of.

structure.raw_value: BrFlDe.I've done things a man your age has probably never even heard of.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlDe.I've done things a man your age has probably never even heard of."

translation: Robiłem rzeczy, o jakich chłopak w twoim wieku pewnie nawet nie słyszał.

source_text: My ex-wife was a wildcat...

structure.raw_value: BrFrDe.My ex-wife was a wildcat...
structure.script_literal: "BrFrDe.My ex-wife was a wildcat..."

translation: Moja była żona to była dzika kotka…

source_text: She was so flexible, she could do any position in the Kama Sutra.

structure.raw_value: BrFrEx.She was so flexible, she could do any position in the Kama Sutra.
structure.script_literal: "BrFrEx.She was so flexible, she could do any position in the Kama Sutra."

translation: Była tak giętka, że potrafiła każdą pozycję z Kamasutry.

source_text: Let me ask you, 1Hero. Have you ever done an upside down cowgirl?

structure.raw_value: BrFlEx.Let me ask you, 1Hero. Have you ever done an upside down cowgirl?
structure.script_literal: "BrFlEx.Let me ask you, 1Hero. Have you ever done an upside down cowgirl?"

translation: Powiedz mi, 1Hero. Próbowałeś kiedyś odwróconej kowbojki?

source_text: Gravity defying, I tell ya.

structure.raw_value: BrFlEx.Gravity defying, I tell ya.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlEx.Gravity defying, I tell ya."

translation: Przeczące grawitacji, mówię ci.

source_text: How she never got pregnant, I’ll never know. It’s a miracle.

structure.raw_value: BrFlDe.How she never got pregnant, I’ll never know. It’s a miracle.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlDe.How she never got pregnant, I’ll never know. It’s a miracle."

translation: Jak nigdy nie zaszła w ciążę, nigdy nie zrozumiem. To cud.

source_text: Sounds like you got lucky.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Sounds like you got lucky.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Sounds like you got lucky."

translation: Brzmi, jakbyś miał szczęście.

source_text: Did I?

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe.Did I?
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe.Did I?"

translation: Miałem?

source_text: Well… Did you want a child of your own?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Well… Did you want a child of your own?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Well… Did you want a child of your own?"

translation: Cóż… Chciałeś mieć własne dziecko?

source_text: I think I would have been a good father.

structure.raw_value: BrFrOp.I think I would have been a good father.
structure.script_literal: "BrFrOp.I think I would have been a good father."

translation: Myślę, że byłbym dobrym ojcem.

source_text: You seem like you would have made for a cool dad.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.You seem like you would have made for a cool dad.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.You seem like you would have made for a cool dad."

translation: Wydajesz się, że byłbyś spoko tatą.

source_text: But then again, the Lord guided me here. Who am I to question His will?

structure.raw_value: BrFrDe.But then again, the Lord guided me here. Who am I to question His will?
structure.script_literal: "BrFrDe.But then again, the Lord guided me here. Who am I to question His will?"

translation: Ale z drugiej strony, Pan poprowadził mnie tutaj. Kimże jestem, by kwestionować Jego wolę?

source_text: You're a good man, Father Solomon.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.You're a good man, Father Solomon.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.You're a good man, Father Solomon."

translation: Jesteś dobrym człowiekiem, ojcze Solomonie.

source_text: Don't worry about Judy. I'll protect her.

structure.raw_value: BrFrDe.Don't worry about Judy. I'll protect her.
structure.script_literal: "BrFrDe.Don't worry about Judy. I'll protect her."

translation: Nie martw się o Judy. Będę jej chronił.

source_text: Oh, uhh... Yeah. Of course. Sister Judy needs our help.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Oh, uhh... Yeah. Of course. Sister Judy needs our help.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Oh, uhh... Yeah. Of course. Sister Judy needs our help."

translation: Och, yyy… Tak. Oczywiście. Siostra Judy potrzebuje naszej pomocy.

source_text: She has a complicated past with that woman, Madalyn. It's really done a number on her.

structure.raw_value: BrSaDe.She has a complicated past with that woman, Madalyn. It's really done a number on her.
structure.script_literal: "BrSaDe.She has a complicated past with that woman, Madalyn. It's really done a number on her."

translation: Ma skomplikowaną przeszłość z tą kobietą, Madalyn. To naprawdę ją wykończyło.

source_text: Whatever's happening here in North Santiva, I'll get to the bottom of it.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Whatever's happening here in North Santiva, I'll get to the bottom of it.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Whatever's happening here in North Santiva, I'll get to the bottom of it."

translation: Cokolwiek dzieje się tu w North Santiva, dojdę do sedna.

source_text: I don’t mean to interrupt you two. But, 1Hero… Your clothes are dry.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.I don’t mean to interrupt you two. But, 1Hero… Your clothes are dry.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.I don’t mean to interrupt you two. But, 1Hero… Your clothes are dry."

translation: Nie chcę wam przerywać. Ale, 1Hero… Twoje ubrania są suche.

source_text: As much as I’d love to stay, I need to get going.

structure.raw_value: NeFlEx.As much as I’d love to stay, I need to get going.
structure.script_literal: "NeFlEx.As much as I’d love to stay, I need to get going."

translation: Choć chciałbym zostać, muszę ruszać.

source_text: Wait. Father Solomon wanted me to make sure you don’t leave before he gets back.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Wait. Father Solomon wanted me to make sure you don’t leave before he gets back.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Wait. Father Solomon wanted me to make sure you don’t leave before he gets back."

translation: Poczekaj. Ojciec Solomon chciał, żebym dopilnowała, byś nie wyszedł, zanim wróci.

source_text: Are you going to try and stop me?

structure.raw_value: NeFlDe.Are you going to try and stop me?
structure.script_literal: "NeFlDe.Are you going to try and stop me?"

translation: Spróbujesz mnie zatrzymać?

source_text: Oh, dear…

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.Oh, dear…
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.Oh, dear…"

translation: Ojej…

source_text: Everything looks fine down here.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp.Everything looks fine down here.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp.Everything looks fine down here."

translation: Na dole wszystko wygląda dobrze.

source_text: Check your bedroom, Sister Judy. The leak is right above your room.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.Check your bedroom, Sister Judy. The leak is right above your room.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.Check your bedroom, Sister Judy. The leak is right above your room."

translation: Sprawdź swoją sypialnię, siostro Judy. Przeciek jest dokładnie nad twoim pokojem.

source_text: Oh, no.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Oh, no.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Oh, no."

translation: O nie.

source_text: It may be several days before mass, but it takes time to prepare.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.It may be several days before mass, but it takes time to prepare.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.It may be several days before mass, but it takes time to prepare."

translation: Do mszy jeszcze kilka dni, ale przygotowania zajmują czas.

source_text: The church sure is beautiful.

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp.The church sure is beautiful.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp.The church sure is beautiful."

translation: Kościół jest naprawdę piękny.

source_text: I saw her go outside… I should get back to my studies.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.I saw her go outside… I should get back to my studies.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.I saw her go outside… I should get back to my studies."

translation: Widziałam, jak wychodzi… Powinnam wrócić do nauki.

source_text: Do you think you’ll stay in the cathedral tonight?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Do you think you’ll stay in the cathedral tonight?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Do you think you’ll stay in the cathedral tonight?"

translation: Myślisz, że zostaniesz dziś na noc w katedrze?

source_text: I suppose it’s safe now… But I sure had fun with Chloe at her place…

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.I suppose it’s safe now… But I sure had fun with Chloe at her place…
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.I suppose it’s safe now… But I sure had fun with Chloe at her place…"

translation: Chyba teraz jest bezpiecznie… Ale świetnie się bawiłam z Chloe u niej…

source_text: And with you at yours.

structure.raw_value: JuFlOp.And with you at yours.
structure.script_literal: "JuFlOp.And with you at yours."

translation: I z tobą u ciebie.

source_text: I’m sure Father Solomon is lonely without you.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.I’m sure Father Solomon is lonely without you.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.I’m sure Father Solomon is lonely without you."

translation: Jestem pewien, że ojciec Solomon jest samotny bez ciebie.

source_text: You’re right. But I do hope you’ll visit.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.You’re right. But I do hope you’ll visit.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.You’re right. But I do hope you’ll visit."

translation: Masz rację. Ale mam nadzieję, że odwiedzisz.

source_text: Of course I will.

structure.raw_value: McHaOp.Of course I will.
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp.Of course I will."

translation: Oczywiście, że odwiedzę.

source_text: Will you stay nearby?

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.Will you stay nearby?
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.Will you stay nearby?"

translation: Zostaniesz w pobliżu?

source_text: I don’t mean to keep you. I know you must get to the mansion with Father.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.I don’t mean to keep you. I know you must get to the mansion with Father.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.I don’t mean to keep you. I know you must get to the mansion with Father."

translation: Nie chcę cię zatrzymywać. Wiem, że musisz jechać do rezydencji z ojcem.

source_text: Haha. It’s only the restroom. How long could it take?

structure.raw_value: McHaOpNo3.Haha. It’s only the restroom. How long could it take?
structure.script_literal: "McHaOpNo3.Haha. It’s only the restroom. How long could it take?"

translation: Haha. To tylko toaleta. Jak długo może to potrwać?

source_text: This is kinda weird. But I guess it’s better safe than sorry.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.This is kinda weird. But I guess it’s better safe than sorry.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.This is kinda weird. But I guess it’s better safe than sorry."

translation: To trochę dziwne. Ale chyba lepiej dmuchać na zimne.

source_text: Jesus… How much did she drink?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Jesus… How much did she drink?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Jesus… How much did she drink?"

translation: Jezu… Ile ona wypiła?

source_text: Judy? Are you okay in there?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Judy? Are you okay in there?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Judy? Are you okay in there?"

translation: Judy? Wszystko w porządku tam w środku?
